roots.origin: 拉丁语 parare（备置、张罗、使就绪），过去分词 paratus；apparare（ad-＋parare）出 apparatus，reparare（re-＋parare 重新备好）是 repair 的来源。与库中 par-equal 所据的 par（相等）同 PIE *per-，但在拉丁已分化为两词，不同源
roots.core_concept: getting things set out ready before the moment comes / 趁事情还没到，先把东西一样样摆停当
roots.core_image: 开场之前，一样样东西摆到该在的位置，各归各位，只等人来
roots.english_definition: to make ready, set out in order

roots.origin: 拉丁语 scandere（攀、登，脚踩着一级级上），名词 scala（梯子）由它派生，故 scale 一支表梯级与刻度；ascendere／descendere／transcendere 分别是往上爬、往下爬、爬过去
roots.core_concept: to climb a ladder rung by rung, up or back down / 顺着梯子一级级挪，往上或原路往下
roots.core_image: 一道梯子搭在墙上，脚一级一级往上挪，也能顺着原路一级级退下
roots.english_definition: to climb, mount step by step

roots.origin: 拉丁语 servire（服侍、效力）← servus（仆人）；与库中 serv 所据的 servare（保存、守护）不同根，de Vaan 明确分立，只是到英语两支都拼成 serv- 而难分。法语 servir 一支出 serve／service／dessert（des-＋servir 撤下餐桌后端上的那道）
roots.core_concept: to wait on someone, doing what is needed at each moment / 守在旁边，随时替人把该做的做上
roots.core_image: 一个人站在桌边，随时把该托上的托上来、该撤的撤下去
roots.english_definition: to serve, attend upon, be at another's need

roots.origin: 拉丁语 mandare（交托、下令）：manus（手）＋dare（给），字面是把事交到对方手上；库中 manus 与 dare-give 两根另有其族，本族按单根体例只挂 mandare，不计入那两根。commendare（com-＋mandare 郑重交托）经通俗拉丁语出 command／commend，再派生 recommend
roots.core_concept: to put a charge into someone's hands and expect it carried out / 把一件差事交到对方手上，等他照办
roots.core_image: 一件差事连着话一并交到对方手上，交代完就等他照办
roots.english_definition: to hand over a charge, entrust, order

roots.origin: 拉丁语 panis（面包）；晚期拉丁语 companio（com-＋panis：分吃同一块面包的人）经古法语 compaignon 出 companion、compagnie 出 company、acompaignier 出 accompany。与 poena（罚、苦）一支无关，accompany 曾被误判到那里
roots.core_concept: people who break one loaf together / 分吃同一块面包的那些人
roots.core_image: 几个人围着桌子坐下，一块饼掰开分着吃，吃完一道上路
roots.english_definition: bread; one who shares bread with another

concepts.concept: getting things set out ready before the moment comes
concepts.core_image: 开场之前，一样样东西摆到该在的位置，各归各位，只等人来

concepts.concept: to climb a ladder rung by rung, up or back down
concepts.core_image: 一道梯子搭在墙上，脚一级一级往上挪，也能顺着原路一级级退下

concepts.concept: to put a charge into someone's hands and expect it carried out
concepts.core_image: 一件差事连着话一并交到对方手上，交代完就等他照办

concepts.concept: people who break one loaf together
concepts.core_image: 几个人围着桌子坐下，一块饼掰开分着吃，吃完一道上路

words.root_logic: pre-（prae- 预先）+ pare（parare 备置）→ 事情还没到就先把东西摆停当
words.origin: 拉丁语 praeparare：prae-（预先）+ parare（备置、张罗）
words.native_definition: to get something or someone ready before it is needed
words.core_concept: getting things ready in advance – 事先把该有的都摆到位
words.core_image: 客人还没进门，碗筷已摆好，锅里的水正冒着气
examples: She stayed up late to prepare tomorrow's lesson.
The cook prepared a simple soup for us.
semantic_expansions: 准备/预备：趁事情还没到，先把要用的一样样摆到位
配制：按方子把料一样样备齐调好，如药剂或饭菜
collocations: prepare for sth —— 为某事做准备，for 后是即将到来的那件事
be prepared to do sth —— 有心理准备去做，愿意去做

words.root_logic: se-（分开、各自）+ par（parare 备置）→ 各样东西各自摆开，不摆在一堆
words.origin: 拉丁语 separare：se-（分开）+ parare（备置、摆放）
words.native_definition: to set things apart from one another, or standing apart
words.core_concept: set apart, each in its own place – 各自摆开，不混在一处
words.core_image: 洗好的衣服按深浅摊在两只筐里，中间空出一条缝
examples: Please separate the red socks from the white ones.
They sleep in separate rooms now.
semantic_expansions: 分开/分离：把原本堆在一处的各自摆开，中间留出界
单独的：各自占一处、互不相连的那种状态
collocations: separate A from B —— 把甲从乙里分出来，from 后是留下的那一方
separate into sth —— 分成几份或几类，into 后是分出的结果

words.root_logic: parad（parare 备齐摆出）+ -e → 把人马备齐了排出来走一趟给人看
words.origin: 法语 parade ← 西班牙语 parada／意大利语 parata ← 通俗拉丁语 parare（备置、摆出）
words.native_definition: a public procession of people marching in order, or to show something off
words.core_concept: marching out in ordered display – 备齐了排出来走给人看
words.core_image: 长街两边挤满人，队伍排着整齐的行列从眼前走过
examples: Thousands lined the street to watch the parade.
He paraded his new watch around the office.
semantic_expansions: 游行/阅兵：把队伍备齐排整，走出去让人看
炫耀：把自己得意的东西也这样摆出来走一趟

words.root_logic: pre-（预先）+ par（parare 备置）+ -ation（名词）→ 事先把东西摆停当这件事
words.origin: 拉丁语 praeparatio ← praeparare：prae-（预先）+ parare（备置）
words.native_definition: the act of getting ready, or something made ready by mixing
words.core_concept: the getting-ready done beforehand – 事先摆停当这件事
words.core_image: 演出前一晚的后台，箱子里的道具一件件对着单子清点
examples: Months of preparation went into the concert.
The pharmacist mixed a preparation for her cough.
semantic_expansions: 准备/筹备：事先把该备的一样样备齐的那段过程
制剂：按方子备齐调好的那样东西，多指药品
collocations: in preparation for sth —— 为某事做着准备，多用于正式安排

words.root_logic: de-（往下）+ scend（scandere 攀）→ 顺着梯子一级级往下挪
words.origin: 拉丁语 descendere：de-（往下）+ scandere（攀、登）
words.native_definition: to move down from a higher place, or to come from a certain ancestor
words.core_concept: going down the same ladder one came up – 顺着原路一级级往下
words.core_image: 脚探到下一级横木，一级一级从梯顶挪到地面
examples: The plane began to descend through thick cloud.
She descends from a family of shipbuilders.
semantic_expansions: 下降/下来：从高处顺着一级级挪到低处
传自：把这道梯子看成一代代人，人是顺着它往下排的那一支
collocations: descend from sb —— 是某人的后裔，血脉顺着往下传
descend into sth —— 逐渐落入某种糟糕的境况

words.root_logic: trans-（越过）+ scend（scandere 攀）→ 爬过那道界，落到界的另一边
words.origin: 拉丁语 transcendere：trans-（越过）+ scandere（攀、登）
words.native_definition: to go beyond the limits of something
words.core_concept: climbing clear over a limit – 爬过那道界，不再受它拦着
words.core_image: 墙头上的人翻身落到另一边，墙已经不再拦着他
examples: Great music transcends language and borders.
Her work transcends the usual limits of the form.
semantic_expansions: 超越：爬过那道界，不再被它框住
超出：所及的范围已经在那道界之外

words.root_logic: scal（scala 梯子 ← scandere 攀）→ 梯子上等距的一级级 → 既能拿来量长短，也能顺着往上爬
words.origin: 拉丁语 scala（梯子）← scandere（攀、登）；「秤」义来自古诺斯语 skál（碗），「鱼鳞」义来自古法语 escale（壳），三者同形而不同源
words.native_definition: a graded series used for measuring, the size of something, or to climb
words.core_concept: a ladder's rungs turned into marks for measuring – 梯子的一级级变成量东西的横线
words.core_image: 墙上钉着一条木尺，横线一道道等距排开，越往上数字越大
examples: The project grew in scale every year.
Rescuers scaled the cliff before dark.
semantic_expansions: 刻度：梯级变成尺上等距的横线
等级：一级压一级排出来的高低
规模：在这把尺上量出来的大小
比例：图上一格对实地多少，也由这把尺定
collocations: on a large scale —— 大规模地，on a … scale 是固定框架
scale up / scale down —— 按比例放大或缩小
words.recall_hint: 梯级等距排开，既能拿来量，也能顺着往上爬

words.root_logic: serv（servire 服侍）+ -e → 守在旁边随时把该做的做上
words.origin: 古法语 servir ← 拉丁语 servire（服侍、效力）← servus（仆人）
words.native_definition: to do what is needed for someone, or to bring food to them
words.core_concept: attending on another, doing what the moment needs – 守在旁边，随时把该做的做上
words.core_image: 侍者托着盘子绕到桌边，把菜放下，转身去添水
examples: The waiter served us within five minutes.
This box can serve as a table.
semantic_expansions: 服务/端上：站在旁边，把该托上的托上、该做的做上
供职：长期在某处替人办事，如军中或公司
起作用：一样东西替人顶了那份用处
collocations: serve as sth —— 充当、起某种作用，as 后是所顶的角色
serve sb sth —— 给某人端上某物，双宾语结构

words.root_logic: servi（servire 服侍）+ -ce（名词）→ 替人做事这件事，以及做这事的那一套安排
words.origin: 拉丁语 servitium（服侍、仆役之职）← servire（服侍）
words.native_definition: work done for others, or a system set up to provide it
words.core_concept: the doing of what others need – 替人把该做的做上这件事
words.core_image: 柜台后的人接过单子，问清要什么，几分钟后把东西递出来
examples: The hotel offers excellent service to guests.
The car is due for a service.
semantic_expansions: 服务：替人做该做的事
业务：把这种替人做事组织成一项固定供应，如邮政或公交
检修：定期替机器做该做的那份照料

words.root_logic: serv（servire 服侍）+ -ant（做…的人）→ 守在旁边听用的那个人
words.origin: 古法语 servant（servir 的现在分词）← 拉丁语 servire（服侍）
words.native_definition: a person employed to work in another's household
words.core_concept: the one who stands by to be used – 站在旁边听用的那个人
words.core_image: 门边站着一个人，主人一抬手就上前，不抬手就一直站着
examples: The servant brought tea into the study.
Civil servants must follow strict rules.
semantic_expansions: 仆人/佣人：在人家里听用、替主人做事的人
公务员：替公众办事的人，civil servant 正是这一层

words.root_logic: de-（彻底、责令）+ mand（mandare 交办）→ 把话交到对方手上，非要他照办
words.origin: 古法语 demander ← 拉丁语 demandare：de-（彻底）+ mandare（交托、下令）
words.native_definition: to ask for something firmly, or the need for something in a market
words.core_concept: pressing a charge into another's hand – 把要办的事按到对方手上
words.core_image: 一只手把纸条按在柜台上，手指压着不放，等对面点头
examples: The workers demanded better pay and shorter hours.
Demand for cheap flights rose sharply.
semantic_expansions: 要求：把话交到对方手上，压着要他照办
需求：市场上众人这样压过来的分量，就是那份要量
collocations: in demand —— 吃香、抢手，作表语或后置修饰
demand that sb (should) do sth —— 从句用虚拟，动词用原形

words.root_logic: re-（再、加强）+ com-（郑重）+ mend（mandare 交托）→ 把人或物郑重交到对方手上，说这个可以
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 recommendare ← commendare：com-（加强）+ mandare（交托）
words.native_definition: to tell someone that a person or thing is good and worth choosing
words.core_concept: handing a thing over with your word behind it – 把它交到对方手上，并为它担保
words.core_image: 一个人把名片按到朋友手里，说这家你去，出了事找我
examples: I recommend this book to every beginner.
The doctor recommended that he rest for a week.
semantic_expansions: 推荐：把人或物交到对方手上，替它说好话
建议：把一条做法这样交过去，请对方照着办
collocations: recommend doing sth —— 建议做某事，后接动名词
recommend that sb (should) do sth —— 从句用虚拟，动词用原形

words.root_logic: com-（一同）+ pan（panis 面包）+ -y → 分吃同一块面包的那伙人 → 合在一处做事的那伙，也指有人在旁
words.origin: 古法语 compagnie ← 晚期拉丁语 companio（com-＋panis：同吃一块面包的人）
words.native_definition: a group of people working together as a business, or the presence of others
words.core_concept: those who share one loaf – 分吃同一块面包的那些人
words.core_image: 几个人合租一间铺面，共用一个招牌，晚上还一起吃饭
examples: She runs a small printing company.
I enjoyed her company on the long drive.
semantic_expansions: 公司：合在一处做事、共吃一口饭的那伙人
陪伴：有人在旁一起，就像同桌吃饭
一群人：凑在一处的那一伙，如一队士兵
collocations: keep sb company —— 陪着某人，作宾语补足成分
in the company of sb —— 与某人在一起，多用于正式说法

words.root_logic: com-（一同）+ pani（panis 面包）+ -on（人）→ 与你分吃同一块面包的那个人
words.origin: 古法语 compaignon ← 晚期拉丁语 companio（com-＋panis：同吃一块面包的人）
words.native_definition: a person who spends time with you or travels with you
words.core_concept: the one who shares your loaf – 与你分吃同一块面包的那个人
words.core_image: 长途车上邻座那人陪你说了一路话，下车时分了半块饼给你
examples: His dog was his only companion that winter.
She was a cheerful companion on the trip.
semantic_expansions: 同伴：一路同行、与你分食的那个人
伙伴：常在一处做事或作伴的那个人
